about_the_game:
Space Bross is a thrilling blend of action 2.5D roguelite, and Tower Defense genres.

You’re a retired astronaut. You had one job: chill. But then they came for your chicken. Now it’s personal.

Set off on a chaotic journey across deep space in Space Bross, a roguelite tower defense action game where survival means lasers, loot, and a whole lot of clucking vengeance.

Explore dangerous, ever-changing alien worlds filled with secrets, traps, and absurd surprises. Each planet you land on brings new biomes, enemies, and challenges.

Before the swarm hits, customize your base.

Strategically place turrets, reinforce your perimeter, and experiment with different defense combos.

It’s your strategy, customize it your way.

When they come, they come hard.

Dash, shoot, and slam your way through relentless waves of alien freaks. Use your skills to stay alive, collect juicy loot, and protect what’s yours.

Combat is fast, reactive, and just the right amount of ridiculous.

Every battle earns you upgrades, use them wisely.

Unlock powerful gear, enhance your weapons, and evolve your tech tree to suit your playstyle. As the enemies grow stronger, so must you… or become space dust.

Space Bross is loud, chaotic, heartfelt, and just a little unhinged, exactly how saving a chicken in space should feel.

What Makes Space Bross Awesome:

•⁠  ⁠2.5D Roguelite Tower Defense mayhem

•⁠  ⁠Chaotic alien swarms & intense boss fights

•⁠  ⁠Base customizing with tactical turret placement

•⁠  ⁠Fast-paced combat and dynamic upgrades

•⁠  ⁠Strategic depth mixed with arcade action

•⁠  ⁠Yes. The chicken is real. And important.

Wishlist now, and prepare for the rescue mission of a lifetime.

short_description: Your chicken has been kidnapped, and that’s all it takes to send a retired astronaut into full galactic mayhem. Space Bross is a hand-drawn 2.5D tower defense & action roguelite where you’ll build bases, fend off alien hordes, and blast your way across planets to bring your feathery friend back.
